kpis.description_fr: ~158 M domaines .com sous gestion exclusive Verisign. Plateau récent. Tendance baisse fragile e-commerce Chine + spéculation.
kpis.description_en: ~158M .com domains under Verisign exclusive management. Recent plateau. Slight decline trend from China e-commerce + speculation.

kpis.description_fr: ~12,7 M domaines .net. Décrue régulière vs .com et new gTLDs. Représente ~5 % du CA Verisign.
kpis.description_en: ~12.7M .net domains. Steady decline vs .com and new gTLDs. ~5% of Verisign revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Prix wholesale .com aux registrars (Yahoo, GoDaddy, etc.). Hausse autorisée par ICANN (7 %/an cap). Pricing power monopolistique.
kpis.description_en: Wholesale .com price to registrars (Yahoo, GoDaddy, etc.). Increase authorized by ICANN (7%/year cap). Monopolistic pricing power.

kpis.description_fr: Verisign exploite l'infrastructure DNS racine .com/.net. ~350 Mds requêtes /jour. Uptime 100 % depuis 27 ans (root server A + J). Mission-critical Internet plumbing.
kpis.description_en: Verisign operates .com/.net root DNS infrastructure. ~350B queries/day. 100% uptime for 27 years (A + J root servers). Mission-critical Internet plumbing.

kpis.description_fr: Contrat ICANN .com renewable presumably 2030 + 6 ans = 2036. Sécurise franchise long-terme. Buybacks massifs financés par certitude cashflow.
kpis.description_en: ICANN .com contract presumably renewable 2030 + 6 years = 2036. Secures long-term franchise. Massive buybacks financed by cashflow certainty.
